item.title: Ask HN: Why not expand accessibility laws to include the right to use AI?
item.summary: All humans are cognitively disabled in some ways when compared to modern AI. I think accessibility laws should be expanded to include the right to use AI to overcome such limitations. What do you think? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49299227 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
